body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung SDI presented 2.2-inch 0.78mm-thick AMOLED at KES 2006. Featuring micro-second response time, it can play perfect video files 1,000 times faster than the conventional LCDs according to the company. Since it doesn''t require back lighting, it can be much slimmer and lighters than existing LCDs. To show this, the company presented 1.6mm-thick dual AMOLED that delivers different images on each side with the two panels put together.
